Nach dem Verkauf Sprint 26 · board 03 · I18 · FR-50 · 1200 px

Where the operator sees what a sale missed (FR-50, I18 modes 1 and 2, today only GET /api/v1/sales/hindsight and portfolixir.sales.hindsight), and mode 3, the purchase the proceeds went into (ADR-0057). The pick: A, B or C. Recommended: C, a section of its own, „Nach dem Verkauf“, on Cashflow → Trades under the trades list, and the same section on a security's Trades tab. Silence adopts C. A comment naming A or B changes it.

Why C: the read has one row per sale booking; „Alle Trades“ has one row per closed FIFO round trip. On the seed the two lists differ: of ten sales, three have no trade row (Harborline Freight Inc and Arbolia Inc. are excluded from the totals for want of a rate or a leg, Saltmarsh Logistics SE matched no buy), and Brightwater sold 13 shares of which 10 are a trade. A and B could only show the seven that have a row, and a sale that closes two lots would repeat its figures on both. C lists every sale, keeps the trades table as it is, and has room for all three figures per span without a click.

Mode 3 sits in C's chooser as its fourth choice, „Anschlusskauf“, beside „Fester Zins“ and „Wertpapier“: it is one more thing to compare the sale with, over the same four spans and the same rows. No figure on any frame says whether a sale was right; the figures are the answer.

dashed = new · amber stripe = synthetic figure, invented for the board (the seed stores no closes around its sales, so the read answers every span „kein Startkurs“ there) · 1–6 tie a frame to its note. The rows are the seed's ten sale bookings as GET /api/v1/sales/hindsight answers them: security, date, quantity, booked price and currency, and the span dates, which decide „läuft“ (today is 06.11.2026). Synthetic data only.

A — a column group on „Alle Trades“ Cashflow → Trades · 1280 px window, sidebar open (1060 px)

1 Four columns after „Ergebnis“, the difference to the chosen benchmark per span; the chooser above the table. Against it: the table already fills its scroller; with four more columns it is 1400 px in a 1007 px scroller, so „1M“ onward is off to the right at a laptop width, the three figures per span do not fit (only the difference), and the rows are trades, not sales: the seed's three sales without a trade row are not on it.

B — a row that opens under a trade Cashflow → Trades · 1060 px

1 Each trade gets a toggle „Nach dem Verkauf“; the row under it shows the four spans with all three figures. For it: the table stays as wide as today. Against it: one sale at a time, so two sales cannot be read side by side; the same trade-versus-sale mismatch as A; and a toggle in every name cell of a table that has none.

C — a section of its own, one row per sale (recommended) Cashflow → Trades, under the trades list (cut to two rows here) · 1060 px

  • 1 The chooser: „Vergleich: Ohne · Fester Zins · Wertpapier · Anschlusskauf“, the shipped segmented control. „Wertpapier“ opens a select of the securities flagged is_benchmark (ADR-0046, reused unchanged); „Fester Zins“ the rate field and „Anwenden“. The choice is query state on the page, as the facet is; a page reload keeps it. Without a flagged security the select is replaced by the shipped hint „Noch keine Benchmark-Wertpapiere — eines auf der Seite Wertpapiere markieren.“
  • A span cell: the lead figure is what the group head names (here the difference to the benchmark), the line under it the security's return „ggü.“ the benchmark's; signed and coloured as every return is, .num-aligned and tabular. The start close in EUR stands beside the booked sale („13 × 33,00 EUR“), with its date where it is not the sale day (Brightwater: sold on a Sunday, the close is Friday's).
  • 2 A span that has not ended has no figure: „läuft“ over „bis 27.12.2026“, muted, never a dash, so it cannot be read as a missing price.
  • 3 A span the read cannot measure is the muted dash with its reason in words under it, and the longer reason as the cell's title: „kein Startkurs“, „kein Endkurs“, „kein Wechselkurs“ (Kestrel Bay 3M), „kein Benchmark-Kurs“. With no benchmark close the security's own figure stays on the line (Microsoft). Harborline and Tamarisk are the read's own answer on the seed.
  • 4 The computation basis is behind the section's ⓘ (idea I1: method clauses in the ⓘ, the gross/net line under the table); the frame below shows it open. The API's computation_basis keeps its own wording; the ⓘ is its German reading.

The per-security home: the same section under „Abgeschlossene Trades (FIFO)“, filtered to the security (security_id=), its heading an h3 with the section ⓘ as the trades list has it. The trades list links each name to this tab already.

Mode 3 — „Anschlusskauf“, the purchase the proceeds went into ADR-0057 · C's fourth choice · 1060 px · cut to five sales

  • No link is chosen by hand. By rule, the buys from the sale's cash account on the sale day or up to 30 days after consume the proceeds in date order, the last pro rata. „Angelegt“ is the part of the proceeds that went into them and its share; the kept side is scaled to that part.
  • A span cell: the lead is „gewechselt − behalten“ in EUR, the lines under it the two values, „behalten“ (the sold position, price only) and „gewechselt“ (the bought position; before its buy date the money counts as cash at its booked amount). Measured from the sale day.
  • 5 The line under a matched sale: the buys with their dates and the days after the sale (one pro rata: „anteilig 610,10 von 655,00 EUR“), then the cost line: the sale's and the buys' booked fees, which are inside the difference; the sale's booked taxes, stated apart and not inside it, because the kept side's latent tax is not known either (both sides before tax; the ⓘ says so); the buys' booked income, named, not added.
  • 6 A sale with no such buy says so in the spans' place, with the rule as its reason: „Keine Anschlusskäufe gefunden: kein Kauf vom Verrechnungskonto des Verkaufs binnen 30 Tagen ab dem Verkaufstag“.

What the story builds, and what it does not

Builds (C)Does not
„Nach dem Verkauf“ on Cashflow → Trades, under the trades list and before „Realisiert je Periode“; the same section on a security's Trades tab, filtered to it.No change to the trades table, its three figures or its notes; no column on a trade row (A), no toggle (B).
The chooser with four kinds (none, a fixed rate, a flagged security, the follow-on purchase), as query state; rows newest first, the read's limit of 100.No second benchmark, no benchmark beyond is_benchmark (the plan's flip „I18 any security“ stays a flip).
Per span the lead figure and its sub-lines; „läuft“ for a span that has not ended; the muted dash with its reason in words; the start close beside the booked sale.No verdict anywhere: no „zu früh verkauft“, no „richtig“, no colour on a row, no ranking, no total of what all sales missed.
The section's ⓘ with the computation basis (I1); the gross/net line under the table; the phone rows under 560 px.No distributions after the sale (price only, the basis says so); no tax on the kept side; no stored link between a sale and a buy.
